parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the main switch part of the wall switch assembly, made of ABS plastic. It is the movable component that toggles the electrical connection.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that allows the user to turn the electrical circuit on or off by pressing or flipping it.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot or depress slightly when pressed, returning to its original position via an internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate. It serves as the structural support for the switch mechanism and mounting interface.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism in place and provides mounting holes for installation on a wall or electrical box.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
